name: Publicly exposed VM with cleartext cloud keys granting permission to access resources in other subscriptions with high privileges
description: A publicly exposed VM contains highly privileged cross-account access keys
conditions: secrets ANY (type == 'cloud_key' AND cleartext == true AND cross_account_access == true AND grants_high_privilege == true)
remediation: Assume keys are compromised. Rotate all keys. Remove public access. Use IAM roles.
